sentences.text: Ceres -LRB- -LSB- ˈsɪəriːz -RSB- minor-planet designation : 1 Ceres -RRB- is the largest object in the asteroid belt that lies between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter .	minor-planet designation	minor-planet designation	largest object	List of notable asteroids	asteroid belt	asteroid belt	Mars	Mars	Jupiter	Jupiter
Its diameter is approximately 945 km , making it the largest of the minor planets within the orbit of Neptune .	orbit of Neptune	Cis-Neptunian object

The 33rd-largest known body in the Solar System , it is the only dwarf planet within the orbit of Neptune.Due to its eccentric orbit , the dwarf planet Pluto was also within the orbit of Neptune from 1979 to 1999 , and will be again from approximately 2227 to 2247 .	orbit of Neptune	Cis-Neptunian object	largest known body	List of Solar System objects by size	Solar System	Solar System	dwarf planet	dwarf planet	Pluto	Pluto
Composed of rock and ice , Ceres is estimated to compose approximately one third of the mass of the entire asteroid belt .	asteroid belt	asteroid belt

Ceres is the only object in the asteroid belt known to be rounded by its own gravity -LRB- though detailed analysis was required to exclude 4 Vesta -RRB- .	asteroid belt	asteroid belt	rounded by its own gravity	hydrostatic equilibrium	4 Vesta	4 Vesta

From Earth , the apparent magnitude of Ceres ranges from 6.7 to 9.3 , and hence even at its brightest it is too dim to be seen with the naked eye except under extremely dark skies .	Earth	Earth	apparent magnitude	apparent magnitude
Ceres was the first asteroid to be discovered -LRB- by Giuseppe Piazzi at Palermo on 1 January 1801 -RRB- .	Giuseppe Piazzi	Giuseppe Piazzi	Palermo	Palermo
It was originally considered a planet , but was reclassified as an asteroid in the 1850s after many other objects in similar orbits were discovered .

Ceres appears to be differentiated into a rocky core and an icy mantle , and may have a remnant internal ocean of liquid water under the layer of ice .	differentiated	Planetary differentiation	rocky	Rock (geology)	core	core (geology)	mantle	mantle (geology)	internal ocean	internal ocean	liquid water	Extraterrestrial liquid water
The surface is probably a mixture of water ice and various hydrated minerals such as carbonates and clay .	water ice	Ice	carbonates	carbonate minerals	clay	clay mineral
In January 2014 , emissions of water vapor were detected from several regions of Ceres .
This was unexpected because large bodies in the asteroid belt typically do not emit vapor , a hallmark of comets .	asteroid belt	asteroid belt
The robotic NASA spacecraft Dawn entered orbit around Ceres on 6 March 2015 .	Dawn	Dawn (spacecraft)
Pictures with a resolution previously unattained were taken during imaging sessions starting in January 2015 as Dawn approached Ceres , showing a cratered surface .	Dawn	Dawn (spacecraft)

Two distinct bright spots -LRB- or high-albedo features -RRB- inside a crater -LRB- different from the bright spots observed in earlier Hubble images -RRB- were seen in a 19 February 2015 image , leading to speculation about a possible cryovolcanic origin or outgassing .	bright spots	Bright spots on Ceres	albedo	albedo	cryovolcanic	cryovolcano
On 3 March 2015 , a NASA spokesperson said the spots are consistent with highly reflective materials containing ice or salts , but that cryovolcanism is unlikely .

However , on 2 September 2016 , NASA scientists released a paper in Science that claimed that a massive ice volcano called Ahuna Mons is the strongest evidence yet for the existence of these mysterious ice volcanoes .	Ahuna Mons	Ahuna Mons	Science	Science (magazine)
On 11 May 2015 , NASA released a higher-resolution image showing that , instead of one or two spots , there are actually several .

On 9 December 2015 , NASA scientists reported that the bright spots on Ceres may be related to a type of salt , particularly a form of brine containing magnesium sulfate hexahydrite -LRB- MgSO4 · 6H2O -RRB- ; the spots were also found to be associated with ammonia-rich clays .	bright spots	Bright spots on Ceres	brine	brine	magnesium sulfate	magnesium sulfate	hexahydrite	Sulfate minerals	ammonia-rich clays	Clay

In June 2016 , near-infrared spectra of these bright areas were found to be consistent with a large amount of sodium carbonate , implying that recent geologic activity was probably involved in the creation of the bright spots .	bright spots	Bright spots on Ceres	sodium carbonate	sodium carbonate
In October 2015 , NASA released a true color portrait of Ceres made by Dawn .	Dawn	Dawn (spacecraft)

In February 2017 , organics were reported to have been detected on Ceres in Ernutet crater -LRB- see image -RRB- .	organics	Organic compound	see image	:File:PIA21419-Ceres-DwarfPlanet-Dawn-ErnutetCrater-OrganicsDetected-20170216.jpg
